author: SurviveHack
title: Churro Cupcakes Hide Chocolate Frosting Under Cinnamon Sugar
text:
1 days ago Cinnamon Churro Cupcakes capture the warm, sugary flavor of the fried fairground favorite in a soft, tender cake. Cinnamon runs through the vanilla batter, while sour cream and milk keep the crumb moist and fluffy. After baking, the cupcakes receive a sparkling cinnamon-sugar finish that recalls the crisp coating on a fresh churro. Chocolate cream cheese frosting adds a rich, tangy swirl on top, bringing the familiar churro-and-chocolate combination into every bite. The contrast between fluffy cake, slightly crunchy sugar, and silky frosting makes them considerably more exciting than an ordinary vanilla cupcake.
Photo by SURVIVEHACK.COM Bake them for birthdays, Cinco de Mayo, taco-night dessert, school events, or any celebration that benefits from a little cinnamon. Pipe the frosting high for a dramatic bakery look, or use a smaller amount so the churro flavor remains dominant. Dulce de leche can be drizzled over the top, and a miniature churro or cinnamon stick makes a playful garnish. Bring the dairy ingredients to room temperature before mixing so the batter blends smoothly, and do not overbake if you want the center to remain soft. The cupcakes are easy to transport and simpler to serve than fried churros, yet their cinnamon aroma and chocolate topping still give guests the unmistakable feeling that something special has arrived.
